The research focuses on the sustainability analysis of processes aimed at developing alternative methods for producing the key components required for stem cell culture. Treatment steps and material flows will be defined, and primary data will be collected from other research partners. Quantitative inventory data will be organized to facilitate a material flow analysis and an environmental life cycle assessment (LCA) that encompasses the processes tested by the other partners. LCA software will be used to support the analysis.

item.description:

Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-11 Restauro e storia dell'architettura

The research is based on the idea that each individual component of the built heritage has followed a historical trajectory extending to the present day. Throughout this trajectory, transformations of varying significance have occurred, all interconnected and consequential, either as a coherent continuation or as a more or less conscious rejection of the preceding phase. Each component therefore bears witness to an ongoing process that encompasses, yet extends beyond, the concept of stratigraphy, embracing both tangible and intangible dimensions. This process is itself a heritage value to be safeguarded. The city of Rome offers countless examples of both individual buildings and portions of…
